meaning.en: The beautiful rivers and mountains of one's country.
meaning.zh: 形容国家壮丽美好的山河。

equivalents: the glorious landscape of the homeland

examples.zh: 祖国的锦绣河山令人赞叹。
examples.en: The splendid landscape of our homeland is awe-inspiring.

examples.zh: 他用镜头记录下祖国的锦绣河山。
examples.en: He recorded the beauty of the homeland through his lens.

usage.en: Usually about one's own country; formal or rhetorical.
usage.zh: 多指祖国的山河，书面语。

meaning.en: The four compass points; everywhere, or one's bearings.
meaning.zh: 四个方向，泛指各个方向或方位。

examples.zh: 他转了向，分不清东西南北。
examples.en: He got turned around and lost all sense of direction.

examples.zh: 走遍东西南北，还是家乡最好。
examples.en: Having travelled in every direction, home is still the best.

usage.en: Often 分不清东西南北 (lose one's bearings).

meaning.en: To force a loving couple apart.
meaning.zh: 比喻强行拆散恩爱的情侣或夫妻。

examples.zh: 父母棒打鸳鸯，拆散了这对恋人。
examples.en: Her parents tore the lovers apart.

examples.zh: 他们不愿棒打鸳鸯，最终同意了婚事。
examples.en: They didn't want to part the couple and finally agreed to the marriage.

usage.en: Predicate; mildly literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，略带书面色彩。

meaning.en: Boy and girl who grew up together in innocent friendship.
meaning.zh: 男孩女孩一起玩耍，天真无邪，没有嫌疑猜忌。

examples.zh: 他们两小无猜，一起长大。
examples.en: They grew up together as innocent playmates.

examples.zh: 两小无猜的情谊，一直保持到今天。
examples.en: That innocent childhood bond has lasted to this day.

usage.en: Often with 青梅竹马.

pinyin: bù shí lú shān zhēn miàn mù
literal: not · know · Mount Lu · true · face

meaning.en: One cannot see the true shape of a thing when too close to it.
meaning.zh: 因为身在其中，看不清事物的全貌。

equivalents: can't see the wood for the trees

examples.zh: 当局者迷，我真是不识庐山真面目。
examples.en: Being in the middle of it, I really can't see the whole picture.

examples.zh: 他对自己的缺点不识庐山真面目。
examples.en: He's too close to his own faults to see them.

story.en: Su Shi, on Mount Lu: 'I cannot know Lu Mountain's true face, because I am within the mountain itself.'
story.zh: 苏轼《题西林壁》：“不识庐山真面目，只缘身在此山中。”

usage.en: Usually followed by 只缘身在此山中.
usage.zh: 后面常接“只缘身在此山中”。

meaning.en: The cool autumn wind brings fresh air.
meaning.zh: 秋风送来凉爽，指秋天到来。

examples.zh: 金风送爽，正是登高的好时节。
examples.en: With the cool autumn breeze, it's the perfect time for a hike.

examples.zh: 金风送爽的九月，丰收在望。
examples.en: In September, as the autumn breeze cools the air, the harvest is near.

usage.en: Literary; describes early autumn.

meaning.en: Foes unexpectedly run into each other.
meaning.zh: 仇人或不愿见面的人偏偏碰到一起。

examples.zh: 真是冤家路窄，竟在这里碰上了他。
examples.en: Talk about bad luck, I ran into him here of all places.

examples.zh: 冤家路窄，两个对手在决赛相遇了。
examples.en: As fate would have it, the two rivals met in the final.

usage.en: Often an exclamation; fairly casual.

meaning.en: Emotion and scenery blending seamlessly, as in good writing.
meaning.zh: 感情和景物融合在一起，多指诗文意境。

examples.zh: 这首诗情景交融，意境深远。
examples.en: This poem blends feeling and scene into a profound atmosphere.

examples.zh: 文章写得情景交融，十分动人。
examples.en: The essay fuses emotion and setting, and is very moving.

usage.en: Used of literature, art and film.
usage.zh: 多用于评论诗文、艺术作品。

meaning.en: To talk glibly without doing anything.
meaning.zh: 光靠说话逞能，不干实事。

examples.zh: 光耍嘴皮子没用，得拿出行动来。
examples.en: Being all talk is useless; show some action.

examples.zh: 他就会耍嘴皮子，真干活就不见人了。
examples.en: He can only talk; when real work starts he vanishes.

usage.en: Predicate; disapproving, casual.

literal: strike down · kill · do not · prosecute
natural: to be killed on the spot

meaning.en: To be killed on the spot without penalty to the killer.
meaning.zh: 把行凶、拒捕的人当场打死，不以犯法论处。

examples.zh: 古代戏文里常有“违令者，格杀勿论”。
examples.en: Ancient dramas often say 'those who disobey are to be killed on the spot'.

examples.zh: 通缉令上写着：负隅顽抗者，格杀勿论。
examples.en: The wanted notice read: resisters may be shot on sight.

usage.en: Mostly in orders and historical settings.
usage.zh: 多见于命令或历史题材。

meaning.en: A very close friend with whom one is in full accord.
meaning.zh: 彼此心意相投、非常要好的朋友。

examples.zh: 他们俩是多年的莫逆之交。
examples.en: The two have been bosom friends for many years.

examples.zh: 与他结为莫逆之交，是我的荣幸。
examples.en: It's an honour to be bosom friends with him.

story.en: Zhuangzi: four men 'looked at one another and smiled, with no disagreement in their hearts, and so became friends' (莫逆于心，遂相与为友).
story.zh: 《庄子》：“四人相视而笑，莫逆于心，遂相与为友。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Noun.

antonyms: 酒肉朋友千个有，落难之中无一人

literal: wait for · rice · put into · pot
natural: waiting for rice to cook with

meaning.en: Waiting for rice before one can start cooking: hand-to-mouth poverty or urgent need.
meaning.zh: 等着米来煮饭，形容生活贫困或情况紧急。

examples.zh: 他家穷得等米下锅。
examples.en: His family is so poor they live hand to mouth.

examples.zh: 工人等米下锅，工资一天也拖不得。
examples.en: The workers need their pay now; wages can't wait a single day.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

meaning.en: Changing in endless ways.
meaning.zh: 变化多种多样，没有穷尽。

examples.zh: 万花筒里的图案变化无穷。
examples.en: The patterns in a kaleidoscope change endlessly.

examples.zh: 棋局变化无穷，令人着迷。
examples.en: The endless variations of chess are fascinating.

usage.en: Predicate; often positive, unlike 变化无常.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多含褒义，区别于“变化无常”。

meaning.en: Still highly capable despite age.
meaning.zh: 比喻人虽然年纪大了，本领仍然不减当年。

examples.zh: 老将宝刀未老，又攻入一球。
examples.en: The veteran still has it and scored again.

examples.zh: 七十岁的他宝刀未老，依然站在讲台上。
examples.en: At seventy he's still going strong, standing at the lectern.

usage.en: Often of veterans in sport and work.

meaning.en: Having nothing else at all.
meaning.zh: 除此之外没有别的东西。

examples.zh: 他孑然一身，别无他物。
examples.en: He's alone in the world with nothing else.

examples.zh: 屋里除了一张床，别无他物。
examples.en: Apart from a bed, the room held nothing else.

usage.en: Predicate; formal. Compare 别无他法.

meaning.en: A disaster that costs one's life.
meaning.zh: 招致被杀的灾祸。

examples.zh: 说错一句话，竟招来杀身之祸。
examples.en: One wrong word brought mortal danger.

examples.zh: 他因泄露机密而惹上杀身之祸。
examples.en: Leaking secrets put his life at risk.

usage.en: Often 招来/惹上杀身之祸.

meaning.en: Very few, like stars at dawn.
meaning.zh: 稀少得像早晨的星星。

examples.zh: 真正懂行的人寥若晨星。
examples.en: True experts are few and far between.

examples.zh: 留在老街的店铺已寥若晨星。
examples.en: The shops left on the old street are few and far between.

usage.en: Predicate; literary.

meaning.en: Living a mediocre, unambitious life.
meaning.zh: 形容平庸，没有作为。

equivalents: nothing to show for one's life

examples.zh: 我不想庸庸碌碌过一辈子。
examples.en: I don't want to live a mediocre life.

examples.zh: 他庸庸碌碌，一事无成。
examples.en: He drifted along and achieved nothing.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.

meaning.en: To shout noisily without restraint.
meaning.zh: 大声喊叫，吵吵嚷嚷。

examples.zh: 图书馆里不要大呼小叫。
examples.en: Don't shout and yell in the library.

examples.zh: 孩子们在院子里大呼小叫地玩耍。
examples.en: The children played noisily in the yard.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.

meaning.en: Acting in an unabashedly nonchalant or arrogant way.
meaning.zh: 形容满不在乎或傲慢的神态。

examples.zh: 他大模大样地走进了会场。
examples.en: He strode into the hall with brazen nonchalance.

examples.zh: 她大模大样地坐在了主位上。
examples.en: She plonked herself down in the seat of honour without a care.

usage.en: Adverbial. 模 is read mú.

meaning.en: Arbitrary and overbearing in the use of power.
meaning.zh: 任意妄为，蛮横霸道，不讲道理。

examples.zh: 这位经理专横跋扈，没人敢提意见。
examples.en: The manager is domineering and no one dares object.

examples.zh: 他在家里专横跋扈，说一不二。
examples.en: At home he's high-handed and his word is law.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 横 is read hèng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。“横”读 hèng。

meaning.en: Indifference to fame and wealth keeps one's goals clear.
meaning.zh: 不追求名利，才能表明自己的志向。

equivalents: live simply to keep one's purpose clear

examples.zh: 他淡泊明志，一生潜心研究。
examples.en: Content with simplicity, he devoted his life to research.

examples.zh: 淡泊明志，宁静致远，是她的座右铭。
examples.en: 'Simplicity clarifies purpose, serenity takes one far' is her motto.

story.en: Zhuge Liang's letter to his son: 'Without indifference to fame and gain, one cannot make one's aims clear; without serenity, one cannot reach far' (非淡泊无以明志，非宁静无以致远).
story.zh: 诸葛亮《诫子书》：“非淡泊无以明志，非宁静无以致远。”

usage.en: Often paired with 宁静致远. 泊 here is read bó.
usage.zh: 常与“宁静致远”并用。“泊”读 bó。

synonyms: 发上等愿，结中等缘，享下等福

meaning.en: Everyone has their own ambitions, and should not be forced.
meaning.zh: 每个人都有自己的志向和选择，不能勉强。

examples.zh: 他想创业，我想读博，人各有志。
examples.en: He wants to start a business and I want a doctorate; each has their own path.

examples.zh: 人各有志，不必强求。
examples.en: People have their own goals; there's no need to force them.

usage.en: Often used to end a discussion politely.
usage.zh: 常用来礼貌地结束劝说。
